pkgmetadata.longdescription: Official AWS Client VPN GUI, CLI, and background daemon for Linux, distributed by AWS as a prebuilt amd64-only .deb (Ubuntu LTS is the only officially supported target). No arm64 build is published upstream. Version 6.0.1 replaced the previous .NET CoreCLR-based service architecture with a single aws-client-vpn-daemon binary and an Electron-based GUI.
